milestone: Attachable unit sensors, ideal odometry and range overlays
emscripten: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.9 (4e4223852a0835923411059a3929907d7df1232e)
changes: Fixed C sensor modules on all nine ground/naval/air unit types; exact pose separated from ideal local odometry.
32-beam LiDAR, 24-beam sonar, RF peer sensing, 8x6 depth camera; configurable local mounts and scheduled cached readings.
Shared tetrahedral terrain ray queries, ocean shelf intersections and unit sphere proxies. No step allocation or renderer dependency.
613 normalized observation floats per unit and 9 separate privileged pose floats.
Independent overlay toggles, selected/all-unit display, see-through underlay, equipment switches, pose/odometry readout and cached depth preview.

checks: Ground LiDAR/camera overlays and depth preview inspected.
Naval sonar: 21 bathymetry/obstacle returns; underwater visibility reviewed.
LiDAR attached to patrol boat; RF detached. Switching units and New world retained the equipment choices. Restored defaults after test.
Sonar attached to dry ground scout correctly reported mount outside water.
All four overlays on all nine moving units: UI reported 60 fps during local observation (not a controlled graphics benchmark).
Air camera produced varying depth returns and a live 8x6 preview.
Underground scout: 29 LiDAR and 48 camera hits; odometry reset to zero after tour change. Tunnel isolation preserved measurements and camera framing.
Selected unit and overlay state retained after reload.
390x844 viewport: page width 390, sensor panel width 390, no horizontal overflow. Viewport override reset.

validation_scope: Sensor contracts and benchmark ran in native C and WASM; packaged ASan/UBSan native and WASM viewers matched for two seeds. The full v10 generator/navigation/meshing suite passed in the immediately preceding volcanic-removal release; generator and patrol navigation sources are unchanged by this sensor release.
limitations: Scripted traffic, no AlienWars training task yet.
Ideal odometry has no noise/drift; RF and sonar are game abstractions.
Camera measures radial depth, not RGB; cosmetic props do not occlude sensors.
Unit detection uses spherical body proxies; no inter-unit collision avoidance.
CPU/Node sensor timings exclude generation, pose preparation, rendering and policy training.
